# entrepot_blob_store (Data Source)

Looks up a blob store by name, including its current usage. The S3 secret access key is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "entrepot_blob_store" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

output "default_store_gib" {
  value = data.entrepot_blob_store.default.usage.total_bytes / 1073741824
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Blob store name.

### Read-Only

- `file` (Attributes) Settings of a `file` store (null otherwise). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--file))
- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `s3` (Attributes) Settings of an `s3` store (null otherwise). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--s3))
- `type` (String) `file` or `s3`.
- `usage` (Attributes) Current usage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage))

<a id="nestedatt--file"></a>
### Nested Schema for `file`

Read-Only:

- `path` (String) Directory holding the blobs.


<a id="nestedatt--s3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `s3`

Read-Only:

- `access_key_id` (String) Access key ID (null when the AWS default credential chain is used).
- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `endpoint` (String) Custom S3 endpoint.
- `force_path_style` (Boolean) Whether path-style addressing is used.
- `prefix` (String) Key prefix inside the bucket.
- `redirect_downloads` (Boolean) Whether large downloads are redirected to presigned URLs.
- `region` (String) Bucket region.


<a id="nestedatt--usage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage`

Read-Only:

- `blob_count` (Number) Number of blobs stored.
- `repositories` (Number) Number of repositories using the store.
- `total_bytes` (Number) Total size of the blobs in bytes.
